about: Labcoon's territory: ONE shared map for the brain (lib/world.js) and the 3D field (labmedia.work pond/labcoon/places.json, a synced copy). Coordinates are metres on the field: x east-west, z north-south (the 3D world's x and z). 'at' is the thing itself, 'stand' is where Labcoon stands to use it. Edit here, then run the site's tests/places-sync.cjs --write.
